## Task

After the user selects a folder, request read/write access to it via the File System Access API.

## Parent Story

LPM-001: Select a Vault Folder

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The app requests read/write permission for the selected folder.
- [ ] If the user denies permission, the app handles the rejection gracefully.
